title: Stringfield files on headband transceivers in recovered craft

tellings.quote: he found numerous mentions of witnesses who had observed recovered UFOs and kind of cutaway diagrams accompanying the UFOs and how in certain retrieval cases, there would seem to be like a headband or headband transceiver uh worn by the operators of the craft

plain: In some cases where crashed UFOs were said to be recovered, witnesses reportedly described the crews wearing a kind of headband, possibly a radio-like headband transceiver, along with cutaway drawings of the craft. The claim comes from the crash retrieval status reports, a series of seven reports that the UFO researcher Leonard Stringfield put out from Cincinnati, Ohio, between 1970 and 1989. A guest who goes by the online name UAPGerb brings it up on Michels' show, saying that the researcher Michael Schratt found many such mentions in those files. If true, it would hint at how the operators flew or communicated with their craft.
